title: Counting Bits
keyIdea: i = (its highest power of two, offset) + (i − offset). The top bit contributes 1 and i − offset is smaller, already in dp: dp[i] = 1 + dp[i − offset]. offset moves up whenever i hits the next power of two.

approaches.name: DP with offset (highest power of two)
approaches.idea: Your code: offset = i whenever offset * 2 == i; dp[i] = 1 + dp[i − offset].
approaches.why: One O(1) step per i; besides the answer array only offset is stored.

quiz.q: For i = 13 (1101), what are offset and i − offset?

options: When i becomes a power of two (offset * 2 == i)

steps: Output size n + 1 including 0? Can it be done in O(n) without popcount?
Write 0..8 in binary and count the 1s.
Brute force: count bits of each i. Cost?
"Bits of i from smaller numbers" → which DP?
Pick the smaller number: i − top bit, i >> 1, or i & (i − 1).
